sentence: For food firms, performance follows recipes that join marketing capabilities, customer co-creation, market orientation and an AI marketing strategy
passage: [Wu & Monfort (2023), p. 484] "Data were collected from 278 food firms." / "The research results of FsQCA find that causal conditions of marketing capabilities, customer value co-creation, market orientation, and AI marketing strategy are necessary and sufficient recipes for higher firm performance."

gemini.note: The passage explicitly states the research results found the listed factors to be necessary and sufficient recipes for higher firm performance in food firms.
